course_info.trial_description:
In this course we will be focusing on helping you ACQUIRE a more native like accent (American). I have experience in Linguistics and learning languages which allows me to understand how to pronounce words and phrases. This will be done through mimicking speech. You will read along with me and follow my intonation. We will focus on the flow, the emphasis, and most importantly the way an American speaker would say it. Only through copying will you be able to feel the way an American speaks. I prefer the theory of accent acquisition rather than accent reduction. This is because it is impossible to forget our mother language. With this idea in mind, it is better to think of it as adding another accent into your arsenal. This way, you will be able to utilize the accent according to the language.

Speaking: Oftentimes when having a conversation with someone we do not think about our pronunciation. It is good to not think too much about it, but it is even better if one does not need to think about it while at the same time have great pronunciation. The way a native speaker speaks is not the it is written.

Reading: When reading aloud in English, we have certain rhythms and pauses that occur. We also connect words and drop sounds. Each language has their own unique cadence, and here we will attempt accustom your to English.
